description: ShareableSummaryStatus reports aggregate capacity for a pool that contains devices with AllowMultipleAllocations.

capacity.description: capacity reports aggregate total, consumed, and available amounts per shareable capacity key across the pool.

fullyAvailableDevices.description: fullyAvailableDevices is the number of shareable devices with no allocation other than for admin access.

partiallyAvailableDevices.description: partiallyAvailableDevices is the number of shareable devices with at least one allocation other than for admin access, regardless of remaining capacity.
